title: Marvelous Designer X Kinetic Rush
description:
Congratulations to all the artists recognized during the last Kinetic Rush 3D Community Challenge, and a special shoutout to those who used Marvelous Designer as part of their artwork creation! We put this short reel to celebrate the top few entries - our thanks to our partners @pwnisher & Corridor Digital for the opportunity to support this wonderful initiative!
